remarks:
Stop searching—this could be the one! Welcome to 239 Temple Dr, a 3-bedroom, 1-bath home offering a wonderful opportunity to make your move in Cheektowaga. Step inside and discover a comfortable, functional floor plan with plenty of possibilities to create a home that fits your lifestyle. Three bedrooms provide flexibility for sleeping space, a home office, guest room, hobby space or whatever best suits your needs.

Whether you're looking for your first home, ready for a change, or searching for a property where you can add your own personal touches, 239 Temple Dr deserves a closer look. The layout offers an inviting starting point for today's buyer, while the property's potential gives you the opportunity to make it truly your own.

Conveniently located in Cheektowaga with access to the shopping, dining, services and everyday conveniences Western New York buyers appreciate. Enjoy being within reach of surrounding communities and all that the Buffalo area has to offer while coming home to an established residential neighborhood.

If you've been waiting for a 3-bedroom ranch home to hit the market, don't let this opportunity pass you by. Bring your ideas, picture yourself making it your own, and come see what 239 Temple Dr has to offer.
